This site is a palace of the mind — my personal vault, but only the public part of it. Feel free to skim through it.

Why does this exist? Sharing knowledge is how we work together for a better future, isn’t it? Why waste time finding out what someone else figured out already.
This is part of the blueprint for Human Augmented Intelligence I’m working on, on how to use computers and AI optimally.

How to get around

  • The constellation on the home page is the vault’s live graph — click it to open the observatory and see how everything connects.
  • The sidebar/explorer lists every room (folder). A folder’s note (folder/folder.md) gives context on what’s inside before you dig in.
  • [[wikilinks]] connect notes to each other — click through, that’s the point. This vault resembles my brain: a bit messy, many different thoughts, but most are useful.
  • Search, dark mode, and reader mode toggles live in the toolbar.

Start here

  • Alignment — how I try to stay coherent and on track in life
  • Meaning — how I make sense of the world
  • Library — the library, borrow anything
  • why you should write — really, you should
  • Travel — what happened to me moving around and what I learned from it
  • Friends — some tips and thoughts around friends
  • Work — some good output of it is here, I’m all for sharing what I learned
  • Shared — what is nice on other sites

Folders have a folder note under the same name that gives extra context on them.
